**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no MFN obligation running against Sanofi:

- **Article IX (Financial Provisions)** sets fixed economics — a $50M upfront, capped milestones ($520M aggregate), tiered ex-US royalty rates, a defined Royalty Term, royalty reductions (no Valid Claim / generic entry / third-party licence stacking subject to a Royalty Floor), and a 50/50 US profit/loss share. Nothing requires Sanofi to extend RevMed terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, or to match a third-party offer.
- Targeted searches for MFN / "most favoured (favored) nation" / "no less favorable" / "at least as favorable" / third-party term-matching and ROFR language returned no hits.
- The only third-party-comparison mechanic, **Section 3.5(b)** (SHP1-SHP2 Dual Inhibitor right of first negotiation), runs *in our favour*: RevMed must notify Sanofi of a licensing decision, give data access, negotiate exclusively, and refrain from third-party negotiations during the exclusivity window. Per the detection guidance, that is not flagged.

This sits at the **preferred position** (no MFN burdening the Customer), so no edit is warranted.
